notes.title: v1.0.18 Improve map performance; add ship list
notes.content:
1. Improve the zooming performance in display mode x4 in some battles.
2. Add a ship list showing the status of each major ship.

notes.title: V1.0.14 Change flying height and course; Sunken ship list
notes.content:
1. A new list In the statistics report showing sunken ships.

2. Now you can change flying height and course after selecting the planes in the air.

3. Better resource management in the application.

notes.title: V1.0.13 primary targets
notes.content:
1.  Below "Back to base", there's a new popup menu item "Select primary targets" for drag-selecting primary targets for the planes.

2.  Below "Show deck window", there's a new popup item for moving the planes in the front deck back to the aft deck.

3. You can see full unit icons in X2 mode by unchecking the "Show small icons" in the display settings.

4. You can set the flight height for each group by clicking the group icon in the "Flight Plan" dialog.

5. Resolved some display flickering issues.

notes.title: v1.0.12 air unit information and back to the base
notes.content:
In this version, we added two features:

1. Select one or more aircraft in the air and you can see the flight route and the flight type.
A is attack, E is escort, C is CAP, R is reconn etc.

2. Right click after selecting the aircraft you can see a popup menu where you can make the aircraft back to base right away.

notes.title: v1.0.11 Option for disabling window edge scrolling
notes.content:
1. Now we have a checkbox In display settings to disable window edge scrolling.

2. Drag-selecting now supports bi-directional dragging.

3. Data error in Coral Sea battle is fixed.

notes.title: v1.0.10 new settings and display
notes.content:
This patch includes some UI changes , thanks to Rowdy Roddy Piper's recommendations:

1. Map scrolling speed is now adjustable in the display settings, and you can use the arrow keys to pan the map.

2. Clock acceleration is expanded to x160 and x320.

3. You can see the type and load of the planes on deck in the carrier list window.

4. The duration for the enemy sighting alert on the screen is now adjustable in display settings.

5. The remaining time to nightfall/sunrise is displayed in the clock window.

Thank you again, Rowdy Roddy Piper.

notes.title: v1.0.8 add pause button
notes.content:
1. Now we have a pause button on the control panel, and the hot key 'P' to pause/resume the game. The state of 'Paused' is displayed in the clock window.

2. We're also showing the clock acceleration (x1, x2, x5, x10, x20, x40, x80) in the clock window
